name: D-Guard Calculator
body: Modernized a video surveillance calculator with capacity and licensing rules in a Go API, a public interface and an internal calibration tool. Added legacy project compatibility, three languages and printable reports.

name: SIP Registration Status
body: Periodic collection and an API with transactional snapshots, idempotent publication and explicit data freshness. A k6 campaign sustained 750 individual lookups/s for 5 minutes after warm-up, 184 ms p95 and zero HTTP errors.

name: VoIP integrations and test lab
body: Evolved FreeSWITCH connectors and a lab with an emulator, event console, and SIP/WebRTC media and recording tests. Developed a Go SIP registration bot with Digest authentication and integration with APIs and MariaDB.

name: Quality Survey
body: Internal feedback application with triage, comments, attachments and transactional history. Local authentication and SSO with PKCE, HTTP Range media delivery, and integration, concurrency and video format tests.

name: Seventh UI and engineering methods
body: Built a design system using a personal playbook: intent, specification, plan, tasks and validation, with human review at each step. Component contracts, token compatibility and versioned references support developers and coding agents.

name: Data and BI with Elastic
body: Index modeling, incremental JDBC ingestion, checkpoints and data transformations for BI and billing. Operated Kibana-managed pipelines, developed per-customer provisioning and applied company and condominium access controls.

name: AWS platform and modernization
body: Built and operates a container platform; modernized PHP applications with queues, schedulers, secrets and health checks. Evolved the edge to ALB, ACM and Traefik across three Availability Zones, with infrastructure and delivery automation.

name: Observability and FinOps
body: Dashboards, alerts and runbooks support critical systems. Investigation across applications, networking and billing validated a reduction greater than 99% in unwanted inter-AZ traffic. Inventoried over 100 AWS resources for ownership and cost governance.
